shared_context.topic: differential diagnosis of right lower abdominal pain

atoms.1: Right lower abdominal pain in a 33-year-old female can be caused by various conditions.
atoms.3: The differential diagnosis includes ovarian cyst.
atoms.4: The differential diagnosis includes ectopic pregnancy.
atoms.5: The differential diagnosis includes pelvic inflammatory disease (PID).
atoms.6: The differential diagnosis includes gastrointestinal issues.
atoms.7: Appendicitis is the inflammation of the appendix.
atoms.8: Appendicitis often presents with pain that starts near the navel and then shifts to the right lower abdomen.
atoms.9: Symptoms of appendicitis may include nausea.
atoms.10: Symptoms of appendicitis may include vomiting.
atoms.11: Symptoms of appendicitis may include fever.
atoms.12: An ovarian cyst is a fluid-filled sac on the ovary.
atoms.13: An ovarian cyst can cause pain if it ruptures.
atoms.14: An ovarian cyst can cause pain if it becomes twisted (ovarian torsion).
atoms.15: Symptoms of an ovarian cyst may include sudden, severe pain.
atoms.16: Symptoms of an ovarian cyst may include nausea.
atoms.17: Symptoms of an ovarian cyst may include vomiting.
atoms.18: An ectopic pregnancy is a pregnancy that occurs outside the uterus.
atoms.19: An ectopic pregnancy commonly occurs in the fallopian tube.
atoms.20: Symptoms of an ectopic pregnancy include sharp, stabbing pain.
atoms.21: Symptoms of an ectopic pregnancy include vaginal bleeding.
atoms.22: Symptoms of an ectopic pregnancy include dizziness.
atoms.23: Pelvic inflammatory disease (PID) is an infection of the female reproductive organs.
atoms.24: Pelvic inflammatory disease (PID) is often caused by sexually transmitted infections.
atoms.25: Symptoms of pelvic inflammatory disease (PID) include pelvic pain.
atoms.26: Symptoms of pelvic inflammatory disease (PID) include fever.
atoms.27: Symptoms of pelvic inflammatory disease (PID) include abnormal vaginal discharge.
atoms.28: Gastrointestinal issues such as Crohn's disease can cause right lower abdominal pain.
atoms.29: Gastrointestinal issues such as irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) can cause right lower abdominal pain.
atoms.30: Gastrointestinal issues such as a hernia can cause right lower abdominal pain.
atoms.31: Symptoms of gastrointestinal issues vary depending on the specific condition.
atoms.32: A thorough clinical evaluation is necessary to determine the exact cause of the pain.
atoms.33: A thorough clinical evaluation includes history.
atoms.34: A thorough clinical evaluation includes physical examination.
atoms.35: A thorough clinical evaluation may include imaging studies.
atoms.37: Imaging studies may include CT scan.

snippets.output: Symptoms of appendicitis may include nausea, vomiting, and fever.
An ovarian cyst is a fluid-filled sac on the ovary that can cause pain if it ruptures or becomes twisted (ovarian torsion).
Symptoms of an ovarian cyst may include sudden, severe pain, nausea, and vomiting.
An ectopic pregnancy is a pregnancy that occurs outside the uterus, commonly in the fallopian tube.
Symptoms of an ectopic pregnancy include sharp, stabbing pain, vaginal bleeding, and dizziness.
Pelvic inflammatory disease (PID) is an infection of the female reproductive organs, often caused by sexually transmitted infections.
Symptoms of pelvic inflammatory disease (PID) include pelvic pain, fever, and abnormal vaginal discharge.
Gastrointestinal issues such as Crohn's disease, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), or a hernia can cause right lower abdominal pain.
